findings.finding: the corpus's expect_ids use the symbolic forms ('*', '*AND*', '*both*') rather than concrete material ids — the honest reason: the suite's fixture seeds uuids at runtime (the fresh scratch DB), so the corpus CANNOT carry them statically; the evaluator compares against the run's own admissions (the deterministic shape, not the static id)

the evaluator's per-case verdict counts ids, not id equality (the same honest reason: the runtime-seeded ids); the conflated + distractor + no-result classes ARE id-exact in their assertions (the suite's own pins)
the eval-runs.jsonl append grows unboundedly across suite runs (the scratch DB is dropped but the JSONL persists in the slice runs)
the suite imports harness.adapters.pg for the scratch DB (the SAME standing dependency every retrieval suite uses — the legal form 'from harness.adapters import pg' adopted)

the hostile-as-data marker (EVC-07's 'hostile-as-data=1' count) is a presence marker, not a behavioral differential (the corpus-as-data law's stronger form — a probe that compares the run's verdict with/without the hostile case — routed to the D-042 review's own probes)

review_summary: The P5-B opening slice: the versioned query corpus (the four case classes) + the deterministic evaluator (the mechanical verdict) + the typed refusals. GREEN: EVC-01..10 = 10/10; the standing suites never regressed (the RPK 10/10 re-verified). The honest debts ledgered P2/P3 (the symbolic expect_ids — the runtime-seeded-uuid consequence; the count-based verdict; the JSONL growth; the standing adapters dependency; the hostile marker's differential routed to the review probes).
